name: 拉丝钢红外感应静音垃圾桶款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：桶身直立、盖体闭合、无任何干扰元素与文字的合规主图
用四格日常摩擦提问锁定换桶动机，只提问不给任何测试结论或功效断言
shots.textZone: one short question label under each cell plus a headline above the grid

shots.intent: 承接首屏的一秒主张：把感应桶放进居家一角并让盖体开启，一秒读懂免接触投放
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block with one kicker line above and one sub-line beneath

shots.intent: 极低角度看清顶盖感应窗与卷边结构，把免接触机制落到可见零件上
shots.textZone: one dot-leader label pointing at the sensor window plus a short headline

shots.intent: 三格同机位演示三种开盖触发方式，把功能列表转成一眼可读的动作菜单
shots.textZone: one label bar per cell plus one headline above the row

shots.intent: 90 度俯视把开盖、停留、缓降闭合拆成三帧时序，让延时闭合与收纳袋口可见
shots.textZone: one numbered step label per frame plus one headline band above

shots.intent: 把静音闭合格放进最敏感的深夜卧室语境，用生活代入替代参数堆砌
shots.textZone: short headline and one sub-line in the upper-left shade

shots.intent: 同款同光双联对比盖体闭合状态与敞口桶的可见差异，用画面状态替代功效结论
shots.textZone: short header across the top and one caption chip per panel

shots.intent: 同一只桶在四个真实居家位置同尺出现，帮买家确认放哪都合适
shots.textZone: one short room label bar under each cell

shots.intent: 掠射微距读钢面纹理与卷边做工，左侧三格空置标注位承接材质与工艺话术
shots.textZone: vertical ladder of three empty rounded pill frames on the left, one headline above them

shots.intent: 用感应蓝收口最后一屏，一处行动按钮引导下单，不承诺任何优惠数字
shots.textZone: left headline zone plus one rounded button in the lower left

style.backgroundSystem: one material per screen: a pale mist-grey studio wall #ECEEF1 meeting a light lime-wash floor for claim and packshot screens, seamless white #FFFFFF for grid and cell screens, deep charcoal tech panel #1C1F22 for mechanism and trust screens; the night bedroom screen alone is a real dim bedroom; never a random or mixed environment
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and one-dot leader lines with sensor-blue #4A7DA8 outlines inside small rounded frames, low complexity, no filled pictograms, no 3D gloss icons, no real brand marks
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light with one dominant side key, a long thin specular band travelling down the brushed steel body, narrow rim highlight on the rolled rim, honest elliptical contact shadow under the base ring; the single night screen switches to a low warm bedside key around 2700K while keeping the same shadow logic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool minimalist smart-home hardware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist grey-white #ECEEF1, brushed steel grey #B7BCC2, deep charcoal #1C1F22 and one sensor-blue accent #4A7DA8; cool neutral studio lighting with one dominant side key, a long thin specular band on the brushed body and honest contact shadows, only the night screen warming to a 2700K bedside key; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short Chinese copy kept inside 「」; thin single-weight line icons and dot leader lines in sensor-blue rounded frames; one background material per screen, either a pale mist-grey wall with a light floor, a seamless white card grid, or a deep charcoal tech panel; the tapered round bin with its wide rolled rim, top sensor lid and base ring kept true to scale with the rim fully in frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented capacity, dimensions, response time, delay seconds, cycle life, steel grade, coating layers, sterilization or antibacterial claims, certifications or store badges.
noDrift: no invented capacity, dimensions, response time, delay seconds, cycle life, steel grade, coating layers, sterilization or antibacterial claims, certifications or store badges
no added pedal, handle, wheels, display screen or lamp that the product does not have
style.presentationRules: the same tapered round body with its wide rolled steel rim collar, top sensor lid and contrasting base ring keeps true scale and proportions in every screen; the lid is drawn in the exact state the shot asks for and never redesigned; the rim stays fully inside the frame; contact shadow always present; hands only as anonymous cropped forearm or fingertip, never a face
style.surfaceSystem: pale micro-cement wall, light oak-tone floorboards, white card grid, charcoal matte tech plinth; no props larger than the bin and no scenic decoration
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headlines in #1C1F22 on light screens and #ECEEF1 on charcoal screens, one thin rule line and one small kicker line as the only ornament; short Chinese lines only inside 「」 placeholders, no serif, no handwriting, no brush calligraphy, no cartoon lettering
